excerpt: Rutter is a unified API that lets fintech and B2B software companies connect to their customers' accounting, commerce and payments systems through one integration. Pricing, funding and alternatives.
content:
Rutter is a New York company that sells a unified API for business financial data. Instead of building and maintaining separate integrations with QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, Shopify, Stripe and dozens of other systems, a software company connects once to Rutter and reads or writes its customers' data through a single, consistent interface. Its website describes the mission as connecting the world's business data, with a focus on B2B financial products such as lending, business banking, spend management and accounts payable. Products listed on its site include accounting integrations, bank feeds for QuickBooks and Xero, and an embedded ERP offering.

Rutter was co-founded by Peter Zhou (CEO) and Eric Yu (CTO). When it announced its Series A on 15 March 2022, the company said it had been started about a year earlier and had 20 employees. It raised $27 million led by Andreessen Horowitz, for total funding of $29.5 million, with a16z's Kristina Shen joining the board; other backers included Basis Set Ventures, Comma Capital and Mantis, the fund of The Chainsmokers, along with angels such as Plaid CEO Zach Perret. In its own post, a16z compared Rutter to Plaid, saying it aimed to do for commerce data what Plaid did for fintech. Y Combinator also appears among the investor logos on Rutter's about page.

Rutter's site names customers and users including Ramp, Mercury, Airwallex, Payoneer, NorthOne, Parafin and Bench. In 2022 the startup Uncapped told Rutter its integration build time fell from several weeks to a few days.

Pricing is partly public. A free starter plan gives 30 days of building with sandbox data and trial access to QuickBooks, Xero, FreshBooks and Zoho Books integrations, with no credit card. The Full Access plan, which adds live production access and platforms such as NetSuite, QuickBooks Desktop and Sage Intacct, is quoted on request.

This page is research, not a review. We have not built on Rutter; facts come from its pages and a16z's announcement.
